name: Lamb Chop
siboNotes: Plain lamb is well-tolerated on SIBO protocols as it contains no fermentable carbohydrates. Choose lean cuts and avoid high-fat preparations that may slow gastric emptying.
preparationTips: Season with low-FODMAP herbs like rosemary, thyme, or oregano
Avoid garlic and onion-based marinades - use garlic-infused oil instead
Trim visible fat to aid digestion
Cook to medium doneness to maintain tenderness while ensuring food safety
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin B12 and iron
Good source of zinc and selenium
